user.title: ChirpStack Gateway Monitor
user.description: Monitors the traffic ChirpStack gateways publish over MQTT, using Home Assistant's existing MQTT connection. Home Assistant's broker user must be allowed to read <prefix>/gateway/#.

data_description.topic_prefix: ChirpStack region prefix, e.g. eu868 for eu868/gateway/<gateway id>/event/up. Leave empty for ChirpStack v3 topics (gateway/<gateway id>/...).
data_description.own_dev_addrs: Optional, comma separated, e.g. 00a1b2c3. Each one gets a device with RSSI, SNR, packet loss and more.

error.invalid_prefix: The prefix must not contain + or # wildcards or empty levels.
error.invalid_dev_addr: Each DevAddr must be 8 hexadecimal characters.

abort.already_configured: This topic prefix is already being monitored.
abort.mqtt_not_configured: Set up the MQTT integration first.

data_description.own_dev_addrs: Comma separated. Update this if a node re-joins and gets a new DevAddr.
data_description.update_interval: How often entity states are written. Traffic is counted continuously in between.
data_description.window_minutes: Window for rates, channel airtime and signal averages.
data_description.device_window_minutes: Window for devices heard, top talkers, packet loss, noise floor samples and TX duty cycle.

error.invalid_dev_addr: Each DevAddr must be 8 hexadecimal characters.
